title: Turfed
summary: TURF'ED, participle passive Covered with turf or green sod. TURF'-HEDGE, noun A hedge or fence formed with turf and plants of different kinds. TURF'-HOUSE, noun A house or shed formed of turf, common

inlines.v: TURF'ED, participle passive Covered with turf or green sod. TURF'-HEDGE, noun A hedge or fence formed with turf and plants of different kinds. TURF'-HOUSE, noun A house or shed formed of turf, common in the northern parts of Europe.
